messages:
Rory: Heads-up 10:05 UTC 10: were seeing tenant activations stall in eu-west during asset processing. Opening thread to coordinate customer updates and quick fixes. INC-4412 doc linked.

Lina: Support stack shows ~37 queued activations; 8 marked high-touch (renewal Q2). Most hang on 'validate schema' step.

Diego: Quick tech note: a schema validation change rolled earlier today increased strictness. Under concurrent uploads we hit a row lock on activations, causing retries to back up. Deployed a soft rollback at 10:30 and reduced validation strictness.

Nina: Mitigations applied: scaled worker fleet in eu-west, enabled fallback ingest path, and increased activation retry tokens. Backlog draining but estimate 4-6 hours to clear at current throughput. Prioritizing reserved/dedicated tenants and those with near-term renewals.

Rory: Customer comm plan (send first notice by 11:00 UTC): short status, ETA, office hours invite, credit + enablement offer for impacted accounts, and a 1-question feedback link. Draft below.

Rory: Draft to customers: "Hi <Customer>, we're investigating an activation issue in EU causing some setups to stall at processing. We've deployed mitigations and expect most activations to finish within 4-6 hours. We're prioritizing enterprise and soon-to-renew accounts. Office hours: 11:30 & 15:30 CET. If you'd like immediate help reply and we'll schedule a 1:1. We'll apply a one-time credit and offer a free enablement session as compensation. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-4412"

Lina: Looks good. I'll send personalized notes to the 8 enterprise contacts and a bulk to the rest. Will flag any replies that mention renewal impact.

Diego: I'll follow up with an RCA sketch by EOD and add post-deploy canaries + an alert for activation stalls > 3min.

Nina: Exported impacted tenant list (37 tenants) and DM'd secure link to Rory and Lina. Tagged renewal quarter and priority.

ops-bot: Incident INC-4412 status: mitigations deployed -> partial. Backlog draining. Next auto update 11:30 UTC.

Rory: Thanks team. Keep replies short so CS can paste the latest to customers. Lina, ping me for any churn language and we'll escalate to AEs immediately.

Lina: Will do. Bulk send started 10:58 UTC. Two customers already requested 1:1s; flagged them as high-priority.

Diego: Backlog rate improving to ~12 activations/min. If stable, estimated clear in ~3.5-4 hours. Will update if anything changes.

Rory: Closing coordination here for now. Post customer replies and any renewal-risk notes in this thread.

ops-bot: Next update scheduled 11:30 UTC.
